# thalassa_iam_policy_binding (Resource)

Manage a binding of a principal to a project IAM policy in Thalassa Cloud. Requires projects to be enabled for the organisation (currently private beta).

See [IAM documentation](https://docs.thalassa.cloud/docs/iam/).


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the IAM policy binding
- `policy_id` (String) Identity of the IAM policy to bind

### Optional

- `annotations` (Map of String) Annotations for the IAM policy binding
- `description` (String) Description of the IAM policy binding
- `duration` (String) Relative duration until the binding expires (for example 24h). Conflicts with expires_at.
- `expires_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the binding expires. Conflicts with duration.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels for the IAM policy binding
- `organisation_id` (String) Organisation of the IAM policy binding. If not provided, the organisation of the (Terraform) provider will be used.
- `service_account_id` (String) Identity of the service account to bind to this IAM policy
- `user_id` (String) Identity of the user to bind to this IAM policy

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp of the IAM policy binding
- `id` (String) Identity of the IAM policy binding
- `object_version` (Number) Object version of the IAM policy binding
- `slug` (String) Slug of the IAM policy binding
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp of the IAM policy binding
